## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed fact has a source link, or an observation date with the exact read-only command.
- [ ] Every address was checked on the network it is listed for (`cast code` plus an identity call such as `symbol()` or `owner()`).
- [ ] `node .github/scripts/check-skills.mjs` passes.
- [ ] No private keys, seed phrases, API keys, personal data or local file paths.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**, if users will notice the change.
